fixed_source_defaults.priceProxy: H+L+C; assign each completed bar's entire volume to its typical-price bin; not observed volume-at-price
fixed_source_defaults.bounds: minimum/maximum H+L+C among strictly positive-volume profile bars
fixed_source_defaults.bucketArithmetic: exact BigDecimal floor of (H+L+C-min)*32/(max-min), upper endpoint clamped to31; no epsilon
fixed_source_defaults.valueAreaConstruction: expand contiguously from POC toward the larger neighboring mass, left on ties, until mass>=70pct
fixed_source_defaults.reentry: prior close strictly outside corresponding value-area edge, current close strictly back inside, current directional body, target POC bin center
fixed_source_defaults.nodePeaks: strictly above left neighbor and at least right neighbor; each peak mass>=two times uniform bin mass (total/16)
fixed_source_defaults.valleyTie: lowest bin index between adjacent eligible peaks
fixed_source_defaults.valleyMaximumRelativeMass: one quarter of smaller peak mass
fixed_source_defaults.nodeMigration: previous/current close crosses the fixed prior-profile valley center in declared direction; target destination peak center
fixed_source_defaults.bothModesRequire: strictly positive current volume >= previous20-bar mean, directional completed-bar body, positive target distance in direction
fixed_source_defaults.target: profile-derived level, not a searched ATR multiple
fixed_source_defaults.invalidInput: no profile on zero total volume or zero range; reject invalid OHLC or negative volume; no invented liquidity

research_caveat: New predeclared binned OHLCV proxy, not real intrabar volume profile/order flow. Existing auction-named families use VWAP/deviation/session ranges rather than this histogram. Shared auction/mean-reversion exposure remains and no economic independence or prospective profit is established by naming. Historical markets and other policies have been observed; retain all failures and original gates.
